comments.mergedPostDetails:
The current build seems to force the microphone input setting to the OS default device at startup.

This is a fatal problem for users who use the voice changer, since the device is still displayed as previously selected.

We hope this issue will be fixed as soon as possible.

===以下DeepL翻訳にかける前の原文===

現在のビルドではマイクの入力設定が起動時にOSの既定のデバイスに強制されてしまうようです。

なお表示上前回選択しているデバイスのままとなっている為、ボイスチェンジャーを利用しているユーザにとっては致命的な不具合と言って過言では無いと思われます。

出来る限り早くこの不具合が修正されることを願います。

details: I use a wireless microphone for VR. Windows default is the builtin VR headset mic. I select the wireless mic in VRChat which works fine. After a restart of the game the default mic is used while in the menu the wireless mic is still selected. Switching to any other mic and then back to the wireless one re-enables it until next restart. The issue did not occur in previous builds.
